## Knowledge

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_knowledge.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The user's brain grows as they study the world, up to 300 knowledge, and never forgets. Sampling a Zoan, pricking an animal, analysing a creature or a Devil Fruit, entering a new biome, seeing or taking a technique, making SMILEs, grafting traits and infusing weapons teach them. The first time teaches most, each repeat half as much, down to nothing. At 100 they can make SMILEs and graft traits, and at 300 they can make a weapon eat a Zoan fruit and graft the rarest traits.

## Syringe

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_syringe.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user pricks a creature within reach, without hurting it, and takes its blood. The blood of a Zoan user in a Zoan form (hybrid or full) or of a creature with a graftable trait gives a Lineage Factor Sample holding all it carries, and an animal's teaches them about its kind. A player lets them only where PvP is on, or when they are allies.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

<!-- move inomissing:nomi_smile_making -->

## SMILE Making

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_smile_making.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

From 100 knowledge, the user turns a Lineage Factor Sample and an apple into a SMILE of its Zoan. A SMILE is either a perfect copy of the Zoan in another colour or a failure that locks its eater in a strange body. A perfect copy comes out 50% of the time for a wooden box Zoan, 35% for an iron box one and 15% for a golden box one.

## Lineage Graft

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_lineage_graft.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

From 100 knowledge, the user grafts on themselves the trait selected in a Lineage Factor Sample and uses the sample up. The rarest traits need 300 knowledge: the Lunarian traits and those of the warden, the wither skeleton, the enderman, the Wither and the Ender Dragon. From 100 knowledge, the user grafts the trait selected in a Lineage Factor Sample on the body within reach and uses the sample up: a player who crouches before them or one of their own creatures. The rarest traits need 300 knowledge: the Lunarian traits and those of the warden, the wither skeleton, the enderman, the Wither and the Ender Dragon. A body holds 3 traits stable; each one more takes 10% of max health and 15% of every trait's numbers.

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_lineage_purge.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

## Infusion

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nomi_infusion.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*
